turns.assistant:
Loading your communication profile, then answering in that style.**Answer**
A load balancer (a tool that spreads work) sends requests to several servers so no single machine takes all the traffic.

**Why**
One busy server can slow down or crash.
Spreading requests keeps response times steadier and keeps the service up if one server fails.

**Example**
If 300 people open a site at once, the load balancer might send 100 requests to each of three servers instead of dumping all 300 on one.
